text:
Alex Chen: Paging partnerships team — NimbusCloud webinar cohost confirmed for Tue June 11 10am PT. Need to lock speakers, demos, and swag plan today.

Maria Lopez: @Alex Chen great. Who's our speaker lineup? I thought we had Jordan and a Nimbus solutions engineer offering a live demo.

Jordan Patel: Yep I'm in for a 12-15 min product demo (LLM inference perf + cost-points). Can do live laptop demo but recommend having a recorded fallback in case NFV on stage is flaky.

Alex Chen: Agree. Plan: Jordan live demo primary, fallback -> pre-recorded 6-min clip + short Q&A. @Vikram can you confirm we have a staging model image + runbook for partner SRE to boot?

Vikram Singh: I'll build a lightweight AMI and upload to S3 by EOD. I'll also add a runbook snippet:
```
ssh ec2-user@staging
docker-compose up -d
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=redacted
./demo.sh --port 8080
```
I'll include healthcheck endpoint /ready.

Maria Lopez: Swag — Nimbus shipping 300 co-branded stickers and 100 tees. We need to decide attendee pickup vs shipping. Suggest pickup at booth + 50 VIP pre-shipped. @partners-bot can you create swag inventory doc?

partners-bot: Created doc: https://drive.redwood.redwood/swag/nimbus-webinar-3790012345. Assigned to Maria, Alex. ETA for inventory sheet: 24h.

Alex Chen: Perfect. Final ask: can each person paste a 1-2 line speaker bio + 3 demo bullet points into the doc by EOD? I'll finalize run-of-show after that. :thumbsup:
